# 陰真君金石五相類

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Perfected Yīn's Metals-and-Minerals Five-Aspects-Class*

attributed to [陰長生](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B0%E9%95%B7%E7%94%9F) (Yīn Chángshēng)

A Five-Dynasties **alchemical text** attributed to the Hàn immortal Yīn Chángshēng (Yīn zhēn jūn 陰眞君), treating the "five aspects" (*wǔ xiāng* 五相) of metals and minerals. Cognate with [KR5c0302](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0302) and [KR5c0303](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0303). Preserved as **DZ 906** / CT 906 (*Dòngshén bù, Zhòng shù lèi* 洞神部眾術類).

**Dating.** Five Dynasties. Dynasty: 五代.
